observations.behavior: Replaces a direct cache overwrite after successful mutation with an operation that first applies pending client-side operations to the cached layout.
observations.posthog_connection: This changes how the desktop dashboard grid visually represents edits while waiting for server acknowledgment, preventing tiles from snapping back during network latency.

observations.behavior: Adds a queue of unacknowledged operations stored in memory until each patch response arrives, then composes them onto the returned document. This preserves user gestures made between requests rather than discarding or reverting intermediate states.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users to perform multiple rapid drags without losing progress if round-trip times are long, improving perceived responsiveness and reducing lost input on slow connections.
